Zooming with the wheel now works in the editor too. More at [www.malgel.com](https://www.malgel.com).

## Fixed

- **Ctrl+scroll (⌘+scroll on macOS) zooms the editor and the preview.** It already zoomed the image viewer, the diagram window and the PDF viewer, but over the writing area it only scrolled: the editor's own wheel handling took the event before the pane underneath could see it. The gesture now behaves the same over everything, and the wheel on its own still scrolls.

## Downloads

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS 11+ (Apple silicon) | `Malgel-0.1.9-macos-arm64.dmg`: open it and drag Malgel to Applications |
| Windows 10+ | `Malgel-0.1.9-windows-x64-setup.exe` (installer) or `Malgel-0.1.9-windows-x64.zip` (portable) |
| Linux x86_64 | `Malgel-0.1.9-x86_64.AppImage` (`chmod +x` it, then run it) or `malgel-0.1.9-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` |

The macOS app is signed ad hoc and not notarized, so Gatekeeper blocks it after download: right-click it and choose Open once, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Malgel.app`. The Windows files are unsigned: SmartScreen may warn, and **More info → Run anyway** gets past it. `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists every file's checksum.
